childTransactionIds.description: BILL-generated IDs of child transactions associated with the current transaction

childTransactionUuids.description: BILL-generated IDs of child transactions associated with the current transaction

isLocked.description: Set as `true` if the transaction is locked

isReconciled.description: Set as `true` if the transaction is reconciled

parentTransactionId.description: BILL-generated ID of the parent transaction. This field is set on child transactions when a parent transaction is split.

userId.description: BILL-generated ID of the user who created the transaction

userUuid.description: BILL-generated UUID of the user who created the transaction

userName.description: Display name of the user who created the transaction

rawMerchantName.description: Raw merchant name for the transaction

merchantName.description: Readable (cleaned) merchant name for the transaction

budgetId.description: BILL-generated ID of the budget linked with the transaction

budgetUuid.description: BILL-generated UUID of the budget linked with the transaction

budgetName.description: Name of the budget linked with the transaction

parentBudgetUuid.description: BILL-generated UUID of the parent budget linked with the transaction

originalAuthTransactionId.description: BILL-generated ID of the originating authorization transaction

originalAuthTransactionUuid.description:
BILL-generated UUID of the originating authorization transaction.

After a transaction is authorized, it is set as cleared when it is complete. The `originalAuthTransactionUuid` ties the cleared transaction to the authorized transaction. The value is `null` when the transaction is not authorized.

isCredit.description: Set as `true` if the transaction is a credit

receiptRequired.description: Set as `true` if a receipt is required to complete the transaction

reviewRequired.description: Set as `true` if a review is required to complete the transaction

complete.description: Set as `true` if the transaction has all the required fields completed

pointsAwarded.description:
Points awarded for the transaction. This value is `0` until the transaction is cleared.

**Note**: Only `ADMIN` users can view any awarded points.

receipts.description: List of receipts attached to the transaction

isParent.description: Set as `true` if the transaction is the parent of another transaction

amount.description:
Transaction amount including fees.

When `amount` is negative, the transaction is a reversal or refund.
* **Reversal**: For a reversal (cancel before funds are settled), `transactionType` is set as `AUTHORIZATION` and `amount` is a negative value.
* **Refund**: For a refund (cancel after funds are settled), `transactionType` is set as `CLEAR` and `amount` is a negative value.

foreignExchangeFee.description: Foreign exchange fee for the transaction (if any)

matchedClearTransactionId.description: BILL-generated ID of the cleared transaction. Use this ID to identify the transaction after it is cleared.

matchedClearTransactionUuid.description: BILL-generated UUID of the cleared transaction. Use this ID to identify the transaction after it is cleared.

cardId.description: BILL-generated ID of the card used to make the transaction

cardUuid.description: BILL-generated UUID of the card used to make the transaction

cardLastFour.description: Last four digits of the card number used to make the transaction

allOf.description: Type of the card used to make the transaction

declineReason.description: Human-readable transaction decline reason. This field is available when `transactionType` is set as `DECLINE`.

declineInternalReasonCode.description: Transaction decline reason code. This field is available when `transactionType` is set as `DECLINE`.

cardPresent.description: Set as `true` if a physical card was present for the transaction

allOf.description: Merchant location information for the transaction. This information is available when `cardPresent` is set as `true`.
Dispute status for the transaction. This information is available when the transaction has been disputed.

id.description: BILL-generated ID of the transaction in your accounting system

billable.description: Set as `true` if the transaction can be billed to a client or customer

integrationTxId.description: Unique transaction ID in your accounting system

syncStatus.description: Current sync status of the transaction with your accounting system

syncMessage.description: Message describing the result of the previous sync attempt

integrationId.description: BILL-generated ID of the accounting system integration

syncRequestId.description: Unique ID of the sync request that processed the transaction

AccountingIntegrationTransaction.description: Spend \& Expense accounting integration transaction information.

exponent.description: Number of decimal places in the currency format

originalCurrencyAmount.description: Transaction amount in the original currency before conversion

originalCurrencyCode.description: Three-letter ISO currency code of the original currency

CurrencyData.description: CurrencyData class for Spend \& Expense Transactions.

id.description: BILL-generated ID of the custom field

uuid.description: BILL-generated UUID of the custom field

isRequired.description: Set as `true` if the custom field is required

selectedValues.description:
List of selected values for this custom field.

**NOTE**: In the response, you get up to 20 selected values for a custom field. Use `GET /v3/spend/custom-fields/{customFieldId}/values` to get the complete list of selected values.

id.description: BILL-generated ID of the custom field value

uuid.description: BILL-generated UUID of the custom field value

CustomFieldValueDto.description: Custom field value DTO object representing the custom field value return on Custom fields for transactions and reimbursements.

DisputeStatusType.description: Dispute status enum for Spend \& Expense Transactions.

ProgramNetworkType.description: ProgramNetworkType enum for Spend \& Expense Transactions.

uuid.description: BILL-generated UUID for the receipt image

ReceiptImage.description: DTO representing an image from the Spend API.

ReceiptStatusType.description: ReceiptStatusType enum for Spend \& Expense Transactions.

ReceiptSyncStatusType.description: ReceiptSyncStatusType enum for Spend \& Expense Transactions.

isApproved.description: Set as `true` if the transaction was approved

deletedTime.description: Review deleted date and time (if available)

reviewerId.description: BILL-generated ID of the user who reviewed the transaction

reviewerUuid.description: BILL-generated UUID of the user who reviewed the transaction

Review.description: Review class for Spend \& Expense Transactions.

userId.description: BILL-generated ID of the user assigned to review the transaction

userUuid.description: BILL-generated UUID of the user assigned to review the transaction
